releases.body:
Use the public `renderer.currentFocusedRenderable` accessor (private `_currentFocusedRenderable` kept only as a fallback), and document the Linux/WSL copy-on-select vs Windows manual-copy difference in the README.

No configuration changes needed — zero-config behavior is unchanged.

Zero-config release.

- The plugin now intercepts Ctrl+C itself, so **no keybind change in cli.json is required**. Install and it works.
- Rebinding `app.exit` (e.g. to `ctrl+d,<leader>q`) remains optional if you want a single-press exit shortcut.
- The plugin only consumes Ctrl+C when the prompt is empty; clearing the prompt and copying a selection are unchanged.

Initial release.

- Require two Ctrl+C presses to exit the OpenCode TUI (Codex CLI style)
- Built for the OpenCode v2 plugin API (`@opencode/plugin` >=2.0.0)
- npm: `npm install opencode-double-ctrl-c-v2`
